numberingObjects.definition: bigint START1 MINVALUE1 NO CYCLE; nextval value remains complete decimal text

numberingObjects.name: new runtime numbers
numberingObjects.definition: V2-XS- or V2-DB- + decimal sequence suffix minimum12 digits; do not truncate longer values; allocated mapping persists across SAVE failure/retry; gaps legal

numberingObjects.name: runtime_sales_number_unique
numberingObjects.definition: ON sales_header(number) WHERE stock_basis='RUNTIME_LEDGER'; preflight existing conflicts, never renumber history

numberingObjects.name: runtime_transfer_number_unique
numberingObjects.definition: ON transfer_header(number) WHERE stock_basis='RUNTIME_LEDGER'; no history_* index

numberingSemantics: Authenticate and verify current command references before reserving
Match stable kind/documentId/account/number on SAVE in same original transaction
No inventory writes from allocation; retain canceled/unused allocations; do not promise gapless numbers
No new frontend mandatory fields inferred from nullable historical fields
Keep old sourceConfirmedCreateDocumentNumber as old parity helper until new number path approved
If pre-prepare request loses its returned new documentId, a later distinct prepare may reserve an unused number; no claim that existing prepare HTTP is idempotent

maintenanceConstraints.receiptResult: strict object {operationId,kind,targetId,version}; matches persisted receipt id/type/id and final root version; no success without audit
maintenanceConstraints.audit: one immutable audit per operation as current UNIQUE(operation_id); bounded sparse root+changed-child facts, exact old/new CAS; no credential/hash/token content
maintenanceConstraints.migrationPolicy: Do not edit migrations1–19. New receipt/audit/check/trigger definitions are migration changes awaiting C01. Preserve all old branches byte-equivalent logically, including IMPORT wrapping and mutual deferred FKs.

inventoryHistoryConstraints.change: 新INSERT可绑定；旧行禁止NULL→非NULL补证，非NULL不可重绑/清除。新行不在初始import_record完整范围伪造条目。
每一维必须为同一已发布cutoff成员或经不可变创建回执/审计证明的基线后真新建。查读/新建命令/首次过账共用；不把当前enabled/version/缺balance当创建证明。保留published_inventory_key原cutoff含义。
日常新键只按已确认公共资格准入；first real delta才建立balance；已有ledger缺balance拒绝；不创建零流水/零占位；保留ledger_retains_balance及数量精确约束。
在现有SALES/TRANSFER/CUSTOMER/SUPPLIER/IMPORT外增加HISTORY_SALES/HISTORY_TRANSFER；历史目标只允许HISTORY_REVISE。保留旧枚举与生成外键。

增加HISTORY_REVISE；operation_receipt.status继续COMMITTED。新result_data确切字段：operationId,dataset='HISTORY',kind,documentId,revisionId,version,ledgerEntryIds；按目标kind闭合，金额单改ledgerEntryIds允许空。保留receipt↔audit同operation/actor/target/action关系。

仅用受控HISTORY_REVISE行守卫替代当前全拒绝触发器；不裸删保护。新stock_effect_basis='CUTOFF_BASELINE_DELTA_V1'；证据固定schemaVersion=1、importBatchId、publishedOperationId、documentManifestHash、previousRevisionId或null、oldEffectiveVersion、newEffectiveVersion、sourceStatus、各warehouse/SKU的oldEffect/newEffect/delta与ledgerEntryIds。原历史header/line/source仍不可变。
沿用每原单to_version唯一及actor/request_key唯一；revision.operation_id再唯一。锁原单后读取有效head，expectedVersion CAS；冲突409；同actor/key先比request_hash，同内容返回原回执，异内容拒绝。

增加event_kind='HISTORY_REVISION'；history来源恰一类+确切revision，与旧live/import来源互斥。endpoint沿用SALES_WAREHOUSE/FROM/TO。source_document_version=revision.to_version，quantity_delta非零，reverses_entry_id=NULL，source_import_batch_id=NULL；基线关联从revision证据查。每(operation,原历史line,endpoint)唯一。
只允许受控修订事务更新投影；每个投影FK及版本/原父单/当前revision一致；不允许普通LIVE改原历史、不允许级联删除。head与line/settlement投影、revision、receipt、audit、ledger、balance同事务。

inventoryHistoryConstraints.object: 库存差额闭合与首次过账
inventoryHistoryConstraints.change: D1公共事务/过账端口增加历史差额source；当前operation+warehouse+SKU验证增量，调拨两端守恒。金额单改不写ledger/balance。COMMIT不确定丢弃连接，保留原key查回执，不ROLLBACK已尝试COMMIT，不换key重试。
本轮只改原单已有行数量/成交金额/分摊优惠/头部金额及已有收退行金额；原单号/厅仓/SKU/账户/方向/审核状态/历史人员时间不可修改；无加行/删行/状态迁移。金额或收退更正后的新有效收退款需配平；未修改的历史真实账差保留，不自动调平。此具体编辑边界须由C合并确认，不能冒充已批准细节。
0001–0019字节不改；新增迁移由D1编号。历史reader当前exact19会拒绝新增schema，D1发布明确逐版有限profile及校验端口，D3消费。结构/函数hash/ACL检查移启动部署；schema变更先使服务不可用并重新验证，身份/授权/当前发布状态/具体键资格仍逐请求核。

preservationRules: R1真实登录、库存/单据读取与schema19真实导入不依赖本轮63个新增字段；数据身份、截止点和实际导入/验收仍必须真实就绪。
仅依赖未确认字段的DDL/约束和写入分支等待；旧字段接线、Demo视图恢复、宿主及COMMIT收尾继续。
迁移0001–0019字节保留；新增迁移由D1集中编号，编号本身不代表已获批准。不得静默补值、改原码或重过历史整单。
历史更正本轮只修改原有行的数量、成交金额、分摊优惠、头部金额和已有收退行金额；单号、厅仓、SKU、账户、方向、审核状态及历史人员时间保持原义，无新增/删除历史行或审核状态迁移。
金额及收退更正后的有效收退款须配平；未改的历史真实账差保留，不自动调整。NULL、明确0、缺字段、未知分别处理。
新商品/资料维护的CRUD/停复用与删除条件仅限冻结Demo和当前业务裁决；删除使用保留身份方式，旧回执/历史外键不被级联清空。
商品默认条码方案与既有每条条码的来源方案分开；修改默认选择不重编、重绑既有码。旧值不从多数/首个条码或当前年份猜填。
